observations: Top-opening chest freezer with a glass lid.
Interior contains a single large glass door and a smaller side compartment.
The interior light is on, illuminating the freezer compartment.
A manufacturer's sticker is visible on the front, but the brand name is not legible.
The unit appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The capacity is not stated on the visible sticker in photo 0.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The actual capacity may be significantly lower than 220L.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's specification plate, usually found on the back or side of the unit.

risks.risk: The cooling system may be non-functional or have poor performance.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with the lid open and the interior light on.

risks.risk: The compressor or motor may be noisy or failing.
risks.proof: A video with sound of the freezer running.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the technical specification plate (usually on the back or side) showing the brand, model, and capacity.
Video of the freezer running with the lid open to confirm cooling and sound.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
